title: submission-templates: the field texts and steps used when depositing works at Figshare, Sophaxis, SSRN, PhilArchive and Zenodo
description:
The field texts and the steps used when depositing works, one folder per venue (Figshare, Sophaxis, SSRN, PhilArchive, Zenodo). The texts of each work are turned into templates with placeholders; every field is marked as verified on the venue's page or as from memory; the disclosure of the use of a language model is a fixed block that every template carries; a field that asks for an e-mail address says only that one's own address is entered. The filled examples are kept as they were copied, with the SHA-256 of each copy, and every DOI in them is resolved at Crossref or DataCite and its title compared.

論文やリポジトリを預け先に出したときの欄の文と手順を、預け先ごとに残す雛形集です。
